messages:
release-manager-sam: Heads-up: prepping airgap installer v1.6.0 for Private/VPC customers, targeting the 03/30 change window. Need signoff on signing + checksum approach.

deploy-bot: CI build 1782504321 started for release/v1.6.0 · image: redwood/private-installer:1.6.0 · status: queued

prashant: I ran the packaging script locally. We need to include COSIGN sigs and a sha256sums file at root. Currently cosign signs the tar.gz but we don't publish a separate sums file.

lina: Agree on both. Also propose adding a metadata.json with image pins (sha256) so offline installs can validate exact images.

qa-lead-maya: QA checklist: verify installer boots in airgapped network, verify image checksums match, and KMS integration for customer-provided keys. Can we get a QA RC by EOD tomorrow?

release-manager-sam: Plan: produce rc1 today, rc2 after fixes. Ship final at 03/30 06:00 UTC in the change window. If signing flow isn't green, we will hold and do a maintenance patch next week.

prashant: One question: cosign requires key access. For build infra we'll use our ephemeral KMS key (path: projects/redwood/keys/cosign-release). We should document how customers verify with a public key bundle.

lina: I'll add public_keys.pem and README VERIFYING.md into the bundle. Also adding fingerprints in release notes.

sre-eli: On the rollout side: we should pin service node images in metadata.json to avoid accidental drift. If we need to rollback, we'll update metadata and publish a -rollback bundle.

deploy-bot: CI build 1782504347 completed · status: success · artifacts: private-installer-v1.6.0-rc1.tar.gz, sha256sums.txt, public_keys.pem

qa-lead-maya: Starting airgap QA now on k8s 1.26 cluster. Will post logs if anything fails.

prashant: One potential blocker: our signing infra uses cosign v1.15 which changed signature format for attachments. I'll pin cosign to 1.15 in the build container and note it in RELEASE.md.

lina: Noted. Also adding a small script verify_bundle.sh to automate checksum + cosign verify for customers.

release-manager-sam: Good. Decision checkpoints: if QA finds >1 critical issue -> roll rc1 and delay. If only minor doc fixes -> proceed. Can everyone ack before EOD?

qa-lead-maya: Ack, will update by 17:30 UTC.

prashant: Ack. Will push metadata.json and VERIFYING.md shortly.

lina: Ack. Preparing verify script and READMEs.

sre-eli: Ack. I'll prepare the rollback playbook and notify oncall for the window.

release-manager-sam: Great — I'll draft release notes with image pins and signing instructions. Posting final bundle link in this thread when published. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Release artifact published: gs://redwood-releases/private/v1.6.0/private-installer-v1.6.0.tar.gz · signed with cosign key id: cosign-rel-2026-03 · sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...

qa-lead-maya: QA green on airgapped testbed. Found only a doc typo in VERIFYING.md, fixed in PR 452.

release-manager-sam: Shipping final at 03/30 06:00 UTC. Adding note: customers with custom KMS keys should follow VERIFYING.md step 3 to import public_keys.pem.

prashant: After shipping we should create a one-line pinned release tag in the image registry and archive the RC artifacts for audit.

lina: Done — archiving rc artifacts to gs://redwood-archive/private/v1.6.0/rc1/

sre-eli: Rollback playbook uploaded: docs/playbooks/private-v1.6.0-rollback.md. Oncall alerted for change window.

release-manager-sam: Thanks team. Closing thread after post-release check at 12:00 UTC 03/30.
